records.section: m46548 — Organs and Structures of the Respiratory System
sentences: A type I alveolar cell is a squamous epithelial cell of the alveoli, which constitute up to 97 percent of the alveolar surface area.
To this end, the lungs exchange respiratory gases across a very large epithelial surface area—about 70 square meters—that is highly permeable to gases.
An alveolus is approximately 200 μm in diameter with elastic walls that allow the alveolus to stretch during air intake, which greatly increases the surface area available for gas exchange.
A type I alveolar cell is a squamous epithelial cell of the alveoli, which constitute up to 97 percent of the alveolar surface area.

sentences: A child under 1 year of age has a normal respiratory rate between 30 and 60 breaths per minute, but by the time a child is about 10 years old, the normal rate is closer to 18 to 30.
By adolescence, the normal respiratory rate is similar to that of adults, 12 to 18 breaths per minute.
A typical resting respiratory rate is about 14 breaths per minute.
Tidal volume (TV) is the amount of air that normally enters the lungs during quiet breathing, which is about 500 milliliters.
